reason: Retire branch-owned research continuation after P0/P1 Operational Spine closure and prevent recurrence of main/research source drift.

active_experiment_exception.rule: The already-trained frozen A/B checkpoints and locked free-running causal court may finish against the exact frozen lineage. This exception cannot create a new EngineRelease, Attempt, Campaign, checkpoint mutation, optimizer step, architecture revision, or product promotion off-main.

scope: generic IRIS VNext tests required for future development
generic dataset/build utilities only when still required
models/tessa/v2 and v3 generic structuralizer implementation still required by current architecture
behavioral-consumption tests that remain architecturally valid
exclude: legacy CAA assumptions that are not part of current Graphics architecture

scope: free-running evaluator optimizations with reference parity proof
fail-closed grammar/decode utilities that remain reusable
drain_slices.rule: The current causal court may consume the frozen implementation. Any subsequent evaluator change starts from main and becomes a new EngineRelease/Attempt, never a commit on the frozen research branch.

never_wholesale_promote: canonical historical experiment JSON as mutable state
dated decision ledgers as current authority
CURRENT_STATE.md or CURRENT_PLAN.md from the legacy branch
old source gates whose only purpose was branch continuation
closure_conditions: Platform rejects new research execution whose EngineRelease lacks exact CANONICAL_MAIN binding to deployed code SHA
all future reusable IRIS/TESSA/Graphics source required for development exists on main
the active Structural-Evidence causal court is either completed or explicitly aborted without mutating frozen checkpoints
no active Experiment/Attempt/Campaign identifies the legacy research branch as continuation authority
legacy branch and archive ref remain provenance only
